subject.title: member-info fails with "fetch failed" on WSL2 in 2026.6.1 (SSRF fetch guard / undici dispatcher regression)

question: Should the Teams Graph `member-info` repair stay inside the existing SSRF-pinned guarded-fetch dispatcher, or should maintainers intentionally move fixed Microsoft Graph calls to a different approved egress policy?
rationale: The observable bug is a real user-facing regression, but the likely repair changes the security-sensitive boundary between fixed vendor endpoints, DNS pinning, WSL2 address-family policy, and broader egress/proxy direction.

options.title: Live-repro and tune guarded fetch
options.body: Keep Microsoft Graph on the guarded-fetch path and adjust the WSL2/Undici dispatcher behavior only after a live Graph repro identifies the failing option.

options.title: Fold into the egress refactor
options.body: Handle this through the broad egress redesign only if maintainers accept its SDK/config/security-boundary changes and it becomes a viable merge target.

options.title: Document an environment workaround
options.body: Use this only if live proof shows the failure is WSL2 environment-specific and no safe product-side transport change is justified.

recommendation.title: Live-repro and tune guarded fetch
recommendation.body: Keep Microsoft Graph on the guarded-fetch path and adjust the WSL2/Undici dispatcher behavior only after a live Graph repro identifies the failing option.
